title: Learning from the Worst: Dynamically Generated Datasets to Improve Online Hate Detection
findings: The paper found that a dynamic, human-and-model-in-the-loop process for generating datasets significantly improves the performance and robustness of hate speech detection models. While findings were not broken down by target group, religious identities such as 'Muslims' and 'Jewish people' were among the most common targets in the dataset, indicating that the improved models are better at detecting hate speech against these groups.
